basic_details.short_information: SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notification for the Grade 'C' Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) 2026 to fill 320 tentative vacancies across six participating services and cadres. content_sections.heading: SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Staff Selection Commission has announced 320 tentative vacancies for Grade 'C' Stenographers across six participating government services and cadres. The vacancy distribution is provided below. The notification also identifies 11 PwBD vacancies under the Central Secretariat Stenographers Service. PwBD reservation is included within the notified vacancies and should not be added to the total. Participation of the Election Commission of India and Central Vigilance Commission cadres is subject to resolution of the recruitment-rule issues mentioned in the notice.

content_sections.heading: SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026 is restricted to eligible departmental candidates serving in the participating services and cadres. The required length of approved service and other conditions vary by cadre. The crucial date for calculating approved service is 1 July 2026 for the Central Secretariat, Railway Board, Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) and Election Commission of India cadres. For Armed Forces Headquarters and Central Vigilance Commission, it is 1 January 2026. Important: Candidates should read the detailed cadre-wise service conditions in the official notification. Meeting a general service-duration requirement alone may not establish eligibility, as additional rules and exceptions apply.

rows.eligibility_requirements: Generally, six years of approved service as Stenographer Grade D, subject to the conditions and exceptions in the notification.
Generally, six years of approved service as Stenographer Grade D, with specified exceptions for existing employees.
Six years of approved service and completion of prescribed training, subject to the five-year provision for specified existing employees.
Three years of approved and continuous service in Grade D, subject to the applicable provisions.

rows.eligibility_requirements: Three years of approved and continuous service in Grade D, subject to the conditions in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The examination includes a Computer Based Examination, Stenography Skill Test and Evaluation of Service Records. The Computer Based Examination will have a duration of two hours. Eligible candidates entitled to compensatory time will receive two hours and forty minutes. The questions will be objective-type multiple-choice questions, with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer. Candidates shortlisted in the Computer Based Examination will be required to appear for the Stenography Skill Test, subject to the conditions prescribed in the notice. Eligible candidates entitled to scribe assistance will receive the applicable extended transcription time. Candidates must take the Skill Test in the language selected in their application. Hindi transcription must be completed using Mangal font. Evaluation of Service Records carries a maximum of 100 marks. The Commission will assess the service records or APARs of candidates shortlisted according to the examination rules.

Final selection will be based on aggregate performance and the applicable cadre-wise vacancy and reservation provisions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SSC Grade C Stenographer LDCE 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible departmental candidates can submit their applications online through the official Staff Selection Commission website. Visit ssc.gov.in . Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not already registered on the new SSC website. Log in and select Grade 'C' Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026. Fill in the application form with the required personal and service details. Complete the live photograph capture process according to the portal instructions. Upload the scanned signature and required supporting documents. Review the completed application carefully. Submit the online application by 8 December 2026 at 11:00 PM. Take a printout of the submitted application form. Arrange for the printed form and supporting documents to be forwarded through the prescribed departmental channel. Candidates should ensure that their Head of Department or Head of Office forwards the completed application to SSC Northern Region within the applicable deadline. Online submission alone does not complete the prescribed departmental forwarding requirement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for SSC Stenographer LDCE 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies the following documents for the application process: Certified copy of the first page of the Service Book, attested by the Head of Department or Head of Office. Attested particulars of service, including posts held and pay scales. Disability certificate, where applicable. Stenography Skill Test exemption certificate, where applicable under the notice. Scanned signature in JPEG format, 10 to 20 KB. Other supporting documents prescribed in the official instructions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Grade 'C' Stenographer exam?
faq.answer: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is the conducting body responsible for organizing the Grade 'C' Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination for eligible regular departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under SSC Grade 'C' Stenographer 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 320 vacancies have been announced across various participating services and cadres such as Central Secretariat Stenographers Service, Railway Board, AFHQ, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and last dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 17 November 2026, and the last date to submit online applications along with the receipt of the printed copy is 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be existing Stenographer Grade 'D' personnel belonging to the participating services and meeting the approved service criteria defined for each cadre.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection procedure for SSC Grade 'C' Stenographer?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Computer Based Examination, a Short Hand Skill Test in either Hindi or English, and the Evaluation of Record of Service (APARs).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this exam?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for this departmental competitive examination.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Computer Based Examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The Computer Based Examination for the SSC Grade 'C' Stenographer recruitment will be conducted exclusively in Delhi-NCR.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application form be submitted after applying online?
faq.answer: Candidates must forward the printed copy of their online application along with necessary documents through the proper channel to The Regional Director, Staff Selection Commission (Northern Region).

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates use their old OTR generated on the previous website?
faq.answer: No, candidates are required to generate a fresh One Time Registration (OTR) on the new official website of the Staff Selection Commission at https://ssc.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the schedule for the Computer Based Examination?
faq.answer: The Computer Based Examination is tentatively scheduled to be conducted in February 2027.
